title: xl twin quilted mattress pad
text: xl twin quilted mattress pad. It can be difficult to find bedding for the xl twin... but this worked and fit perfectly. It washed and dried beautifully and still fit.  It is staying tucked all around.  The quilted top is pretty thin, but I have it on a memory foam mattress so I don't need it to be plush.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
